description: Pay an agent-to-agent invoice by ID. Retrieves the invoice, runs settlement via POST /settle, and marks the invoice PAID on success. In sandbox mode returns a simulated receipt; in live mode returns execution parameters for on-chain completion.

recipientAddress.description: Payee wallet address (required if not set in invoice)

sandbox.description: True for sandbox simulation. Default: true — set false only for live execution.

name: invoice.pay
